Title: Data Scientist, Credit Risk
Description: About Us At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked. We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavor Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better. About The Role As a Data Scientist on our Credit Risk team, you will help decide who we lend to, how much, and at what price. You will use machine learning, statistics, and experimentation to design, build, and deploy the models behind our underwriting, credit limit, and pricing decisions. This is a high-impact role: your work shows up directly in loss rates, revenue, and our customers' access to responsible credit. We are looking for a semi-senior data scientist who wants to own problems end-to-end: from the business question, to a model in production. Responsibilities End-to-End Model Development: Own the entire lifecycle of credit risk and pricing models, from data exploration and feature engineering to model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring. Examples include probability-of-default scores for underwriting, credit limit assignment, risk-based pricing, and collections ML models. Credit Strategy & Pricing: Turn model scores into decisions that balance growth, losses, and unit economics: approval cutoffs, credit limits and line increases, prices, and repayment and collections strategies. Advanced Analysis: Conduct deep-dive investigations into repayment behavior, delinquency, roll rates, and vintage performance to catch emerging risks early and find segments where we can safely lend more. Experimentation: Design and execute A/B tests to measure the impact of new models, policies, credit limits, and prices on both credit performance (delinquency, losses) and business outcomes (approvals, conversion, revenue). Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Credit, Engineering, Finance, and Operations teams to translate business needs into data science solutions and communicate complex results to non-technical audiences Productionalize Models: Deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models in a cloud environment, ensuring high availability and catching performance degradation and drift before they affect decisions. Reporting & Visualization: Build and maintain dashboards using tools like Tableau or Looker to track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as approval rates, delinquency and loss rates, and model performance. Requirements Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in applied data science, and 2+ years of experience working on credit risk or fraud. Credit Risk & Pricing Models: Exposure to building machine learning models for credit risk and/or pricing (e.g., probability of default, underwriting, credit limit, or risk-based pricing models). Python: Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis and modeling, including pandas, scikit-learn, and frameworks such as XGBoost, LightGBM, or similar. SQL: Advanced SQL skills for complex data extraction and manipulation. Feature Engineering: Strong feature engineering skills. You know how to extract signal from messy, sparse, or heterogeneous financial data such as transaction histories, repayment behavior, and bank cash flows. Model Lifecycle & Cloud: Proven experience building, deploying, and monitoring production models on a cloud platform like GCP, AWS, or Azure, including alerting on performance degradation and concept drift. AI Fluency: Strong, everyday use of AI tools (e.g., coding assistants and AI agents) to move faster across coding, analysis, and documentation, with the judgment to verify what they produce. Communication: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Language: Advanced English level. Nice to Have Causal Inference: Experience in causal inference (e.g., difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, or uplift modeling). Domain Experience: Direct experience in consumer lending, BNPL, FinTech, or payments. DBT: Experience building data models and pipelines with DBT. MLOps: Hands-on MLOps experience (e.g., CI/CD for models, versioning, feature stores, automated retraining). Model Explainability: Knowledge of model explainability frameworks like SHAP or LIME, ideally applied to explaining credit decisions. GCP / Vertex AI Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especially BigQuery and Vertex AI. These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. Title: Sr. Data Scientist, Financial Services Mexico
Description: Description Lead the development, validation, and governance of the full suite of risk models for a high-growth payment product in Mexico, directly shaping the analytical foundation that drives every business decision across the product lifecycle. If you thrive on building scorecards from the ground up — starting with external data and expert-rule frameworks when proprietary data does not yet exist, then architecting the transition to custom models as portfolio mature — this is your opportunity to establish and scale a risk modeling function from inception. As Sr. Data Scientist, you will own the end-to-end model roadmap spanning origination, behavioral, delinquency propensity, collections, recovery, analytical fraud, and reserve input models. You will define development standards, documentation practices, versioning protocols, and monitoring frameworks with the rigor required to withstand audit scrutiny and regulatory review. Your work is both tactical and strategic: you will manage complex, cross-functional model programs with negotiated and defined obligations, influencing roadmaps, business and technology decisions, and model governance across the organization. Success in this role is measured by discriminatory power (KS, Gini) and its stability over time, Population Stability Index (PSI) of variables and scores, development-to-implementation cycle time, and the absence of validation findings. In a new product, the first 12 to 18 months are typically operated with generic or bureau scorecards and expert rules; this role requires someone who knows how to launch without proprietary data and plan the deliberate transition to custom models built on proprietary performance data as vintages mature. Key job responsibilities You will own and execute the model roadmap covering origination scorecards, behavioral scorecards, delinquency propensity models, collections and recovery models, analytical fraud models, and reserve inputs (PD, LGD, EAD). You will manage the full model lifecycle: development, validation, approval, implementation, ongoing monitoring, recalibration, and retirement. You will develop the origination scorecard, including reject inference methodology, and lead feature engineering across external data sources, and partner transactional data. You will build behavioral scorecards,payment propensity, contactability, and recovery models and produce PD, LGD, and EAD inputs for reserves calculation. You will own model validation end-to-end: conducting conceptual soundness reviews, replicating results, performing stress testing and stability analysis, and issuing formal opinions with findings, severity classifications, and remediation timelines. You will produce complete technical documentation and model files to the standard required for third-party review. A day in the life You will join working sessions with the risk team to translate champion/challenger experiment results into model refinement priorities, and calibrate payment propensity and contactability models against real-world recovery outcomes. You will coordinate with engineering to validate that deployed model versions match approved specifications and prepare the model performance package for the credit and risk committees. About The Team We are a team at Amazon building a new business, and we sit within the Payments organization. Today the team is small by design, which means you will have an outsized role in shaping our credit risk function, processes, and culture from day one. Our closest partners span finance, technology, and commercial teams, and together we are investing in creating a world-class underwriting and credit risk capability. If you want to help define something new at Amazon and see your work directly reflected in the product, we would love to hear from you. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience 4+ years of data scientist experience Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression Preferred Qualifications 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience Experience managing data pipelines Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Support Data Analyst

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical rigor with hands-on experience in operational data, development of complex analytical models to find creative solutions to unique problems, and a passion for clear, compelling data visualization. and diagnose performance by factors such as issue type, priority, product, region, support tier, and ownership Define, maintain, and evolve operational KPIs and performance metrics Identify risks and opportunities related to workload, service levels, and customer outcomes Data Visualization & Analytical Storytelling Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using enterprise visualization tools Create visualizations that emphasize trends, drivers, and leading indicators rather than static metrics Translate complex analyses into clear, executive-ready narratives Tailor platforms Develop complete modeling and analytical solutions in Python Partner with data science teams to support data models, transformations, and integrations Understand data refresh cycles, latency, and lineage to ensure reliable and trusted reporting Business Partnership & Influence Partner with Support leadership to understand business questions and priorities Proactively identify opportunities to improve operational performance through data Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders across levels and functions Act as a trusted analytical advisor to leadership Governance, Quality, & Continuous Improvement Establish and document metric definitions and reporting standards Ensure consistency and accuracy across dashboards and reports Improve analytical frameworks as business needs and Support operations evolve Promote best practices in analytics, data visualization, and governance Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Economics/Business, data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar) Expertise in SQL for data extraction and analysis Proficiency with Python for advanced modeling Ability to work with large, complex datasets and draw meaningful conclusions Strong communication skills with the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences Ability to work effectively across global teams, with strong initiative to independently identify data owners, track down information, and build cross-functional relationships Preferred Qualifications Experience analyzing support or customer service concepts, or ETL processes Experience influencing stakeholders and driving change through insights What Success Looks Like in This Role Leadership trusts your analysis to guide decisions Dashboards insight

Title: Ingeniero de Soluciones AI - Trabajo Remoto

Ingeniero de Soluciones AI en BairesDev Diseña e implementa soluciones impulsadas por AI que resuelven desafíos complejos de negocio. Este rol combina expertise técnica en inteligencia artificial con arquitectura de soluciones, enfocándose en la construcción de aplicaciones de AI escalables, integración de modelos de machine learning y colaboración con stakeholders para entregar sistemas inteligentes de alto impacto. Qué Harás: - Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones de AI que atiendan necesidades de negocio y requisitos técnicos. - Construir e implementar modelos de machine learning y aplicaciones de AI en varias plataformas. - Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para integrar capacidades de AI en sistemas existentes. - Optimizar flujos de trabajo de AI para performance, precisión y escalabilidad. - Evaluar e implementar herramientas, frameworks y mejores prácticas de AI. - Brindar orientación técnica y soporte a los miembros del equipo en proyectos de AI. Cumple otras funciones y obligaciones que se le asignen. REQUERIMIENTOS: Experiencia en manejo de datos (volúmenes). Experiencia en reportería. Experiencia en creación de Dashboard. Experiencia en escalamientos para fraudes. Deseable conocimientos en MIS y Customer Experience. Title: Banamex - Data/Information Mgt Int Anlst

Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the sub function/ job family. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams. Responsibilities: This function covers incumbents responsible for various data activities, which include database administration, data analysis, maintenance, data quality, and database management or database architecture / design engineering Responsible for routine operational or administrative work Day-to-day actions are focused on administering defined procedures, analyses and report preparation Individuals will have their work thoroughly reviewed and checked by more senior incumbents and will have limited contact outside their immediate area Daily deliverable of routine and defined outputs, while at the same time developing knowledge of the broader context in which the work is being performed Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency. Qualifications: 2-5 years relevant experience Ability to think strategically and the ability to engage resources outside of their direct control to achieve objectives Know-how on analytic tools (SAS E-miner, Knowledge Seeker, SPSS etc.) Big data and machine learning experiences are (R, Python etc.) Education: Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required. Objetivo del puesto Asegurar la extracción, procesamiento, validación y entrega oportuna de insumos de información estratégica a partir de grandes volúmenes de datos, mediante el desarrollo de flujos automatizados y consultas analíticas, con el fin de habilitar la ejecución precisa de campañas comerciales y programas de beneficios para clientes en productos de consumo (tarjetas de crédito, tarjetas de débito, créditos de nómina y créditos personales), garantizando la integridad de los datos y el cumplimiento de controles operativos bajo el esquema Maker-Checker. Administrar y dar seguimiento de los diferentes controles derivados de EUCs y líneas ARCM. Funciones principales Extracción y procesamiento de datos: Gestionar y analizar grandes bases de datos mediante programación en SAS Enterprise Guide, código SAS base y PROC SQL para generar los insumos requeridos en campañas de otorgamiento de beneficios. Levantamiento de requerimientos: Colaborar y mantener reuniones recurrentes con las distintas gerencias de producto para comprender sus objetivos comerciales, traducir sus necesidades de negocio en reglas de negocio y definir los criterios técnicos de cada campaña. Control de calidad y validación (Maker-Checker): Fungir como validador (Checker) de los procesos, códigos y resultados generados por otros analistas (Makers), asegurando la exactitud, consistencia y apego a las reglas antes de la liberación de información. Soporte y consultoría de información: Atender y resolver dudas de usuarios internos y áreas de negocio respecto al contenido, estructura, disponibilidad y correcto uso de la información almacenada en los sistemas institucionales. Documentación y mejora continua: Documentar procesos, diccionarios de datos y lógicas de extracción para asegurar la trazabilidad operativa y optimizar tiempos de ejecución. Experiencia requerida: Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, inteligencia de negocios (BI), análisis financiero o gestión de campañas dentro del sector financiero o bancario. Experiencia comprobable trabajando con información de productos financieros de consumo (tarjetas de crédito, tarjetas de débito, créditos de nómina y créditos personales). Deseable: Experiencia previa consultando y explotando bases de datos en entornos Teradata, así como conocimiento de los sistemas core y repositorios que almacenan información bancaria. Conocimientos técnicos: Indispensable: Dominio avanzado de SAS Enterprise Guide, programación en código SAS y PROC SQL para manipulación de grandes volúmenes de datos. Intermedio: Manejo de paquetería Microsoft Office (especialmente Excel para análisis y validación de cifras). Deseable: Conocimiento del idioma inglés a nivel lectura técnica o intermedio (no excluyente). Competencias y habilidades: Pensamiento analítico: Capacidad para interpretar reglas de negocio complejas, detectar inconsistencias en los datos y realizar conciliaciones de cifras con alto nivel de detalle. Autodidacta y proactivo: Facilidad para investigar de forma autónoma estructuras de tablas, nuevos sistemas de información y optimizar consultas sin supervisión constante. Comunicación efectiva: Habilidad para interactuar con perfiles técnicos y gerencias de negocio, logrando acuerdos claros sobre alcances y tiempos de entrega. ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family Group: Decision Management ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family: Data/Information Management ------------------------------------------------------ Time Type: Full time ------------------------------------------------------ Most Relevant Skills Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------ Other Relevant Skills For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. ------------------------------------------------------ Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Title: Analista de Datos para Programas de Soporte a Pacientes
Description: Únete a nosotros en nuestro emocionante trayecto! Apoyar la administración de información relacionada con canales digitales y asignaciones territoriales. Brindar soporte a usuarios internos en temas relacionados con dashboards, reportes y análisis de datos. Gestionar y dar seguimiento a incidencias o requerimientos relacionados con la información del programa. Capacitar y acompañar a usuarios en la interpretación y uso de herramientas de análisis. Title: Technical Lead Data
Industries: Insurance and Business Consulting and Services
Description: Location: Mexico City/MX or Toronto/CA Hybrid mode This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead a squad of data engineers and you also build things yourself. You're the person who can whiteboard a data model in the morning, pair with an engineer on a tricky pipeline in the afternoon, and present a delivery plan to a business stakeholder before end of day. You don't just point; you drive. You'll own technical delivery for priority initiatives within Marsh’s Innovation & Data Office (IDO). The expectation is fungibility, not permanent domain alignment. As IDO's priorities evolve, so will yours. The constant is the quality of your engineering leadership, not the label on the work. Your squad will be a mix of employees and contractors, and you'll be responsible for making that team perform as a unit: setting standards, unblocking problems, mentoring engineers, and holding the bar on quality. The work lands in Databricks. The outcomes land in the business. The key distinction: This is not a people-management role that happens to involve data. It's a hands-on technical leadership role where managing people is one of the things you do, alongside designing architectures, writing code, reviewing PRs, and solving hard data problems. If your last few years have been spent in meetings about data rather than working with data, this isn't the right fit. What You Will Do: Lead a delivery squad. You'll run a pod of 4-8 data engineers (employees and contractors) assembled against a business outcome. You set the technical direction, decompose work, manage sprint-level execution, and are accountable for what the squad ships. When the initiative concludes or transitions to steady state, you and your engineers move to the next priority. Build with your hands. You write code. You build pipelines. You debug production issues. You're comfortable in SQL, Python, and Spark, and you use them regularly, not as a party trick, but as your primary tools. When something is broken or behind, you can step in and do the work, not just escalate it. Design before you build. You think in terms of data models, medallion architectures, ingestion contracts, and reusable patterns. You design solutions that are maintainable and that the next engineer can understand without an archaeology expedition. You care about schema evolution, data quality checks, idempotency, and lineage, not because someone told you to, but because you've been burned when those things were missing. Engage with the business. You're not building pipelines into a void. You'll work directly with Engagement Leads and business stakeholders to understand what they need, why they need it, and what "done" looks like. You translate business problems into data solutions and push back when what's being asked for doesn't make technical sense. You're comfortable in a room with non-technical leaders and can explain complexity without hiding behind jargon. Drive engineering standards. CI/CD, version control, testing, code review, documentation: these aren't aspirational for you, they're how you've always worked. You'll bring these practices to your squad and raise the bar for everyone around you. You care about developer experience and operational excellence, not just feature delivery. Operate on a modern stack. The platform is Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Spark, medallion architecture) running on AWS and Azure. You'll work with infrastructure-as-code, Git-based workflows, and pipeline orchestration tooling. If you've spent the last several years in the Databricks ecosystem, great. If you've built equivalent capabilities on other modern platforms and can ramp quickly, that works too. What We're Looking For: Essential: 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with at least some time leading or mentoring other engineers Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Spark, used recently and regularly, not years ago Real experience with cloud data platforms (Databricks strongly preferred; Snowflake, Synapse, or similar accepted) on AWS, Azure, or GCP Demonstrated ability to lead a mixed team of employees and contractors: setting expectations, managing performance, building cohesion across employment types Fluency with modern engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code, DataOps The instinct to understand why something is being built, not just how. Intellectual curiosity about the business domain you're working in Clear communication skills; you can explain a technical tradeoff to a business leader and a business requirement to an engineer with equal ease Valued: Experience with Databricks specifically: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, medallion architecture, Databricks workflows Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks Familiarity with data governance patterns: lineage, access controls, metadata management, data quality frameworks Prior work in financial services, insurance, benefits, or consulting environments Experience with document or unstructured data ingestion pipelines Exposure to LLM-based tooling, AI-assisted development, or analytics engineering Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. Intermediate to advanced English proficiency.

Title: Analyst Logistics Systems Configuration
Description: Job Description Ciudad de México Nivel de Estudios Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field; a logistics or supply chain degree is preferred. Experiencia Requerida 2+ years of experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, systems support, data management, or a related analytical role; experience with TMS configuration or administration preferred. Experience using or supporting a TMS platform (Blue Yonder, Oracle, or SAP preferred) and/or Shipment Visibility tools, with strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Power BI experience and proficiency with the Microsoft Suite (particularly Excel); advanced English (reading, writing, and speaking) Habilidades ERP experience (SAP preferred) and hands-on experience with logistics software (YMS, WMS). Basic programming skills and experience with low/no-code platforms (Python, Postman, JavaScript). Experience with GPS tracking systems for transportation companies, including EDI & API communications. Logistics knowledge of truckload, rail, and/or marine transportation. Familiarity with GPS/IoT technologies, such as RFID and/or BLE tags, and their application in logistics. Experience with Agile development methodologies. Resumen The Analyst, Logistics Systems Configuration is responsible for supporting the configuration, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of the Transportation Management System (TMS), Shipment Visibility, Yard Management Systems (YMS), and Appointment Scheduling tools to streamline transportation processes across the integrated supply chain. Working as a system superuser and operational support resource, this role maintains master data, carriers, rates, and routes to align with business requirements while supporting timely and accurate shipment visibility. Covering multiple sourcing categories (can, ingredients, packaging, crowns, glass, reverse logistics, and finished goods) across all modes of transportation, the role contributes to the company’s logistics systems journey by adopting new technologies, methods, and processes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable coordinating with carriers, logistics service providers, IT, and internal business partners to resolve system and data issues. Responsabilidades TMS Configuration & Master Data Support system configuration and ongoing maintenance of master data, carriers, rates, and routes to align with business requirements and goals. Build and maintain automations for logistics systems tools using low-code and AI-assisted tools. This includes writing automated functional and regression tests in Playwright with GitHub Copilot to check SAP TM, Shipment Visibility and Appointment Scheduling, and creating Google Apps Script and Power Automate flows to remove repetitive manual tasks such as data extracts, notifications, report distribution and file uploads. Document requirements and business rules for each automation, test it before use, monitor runs and fix or escalate errors, and keep scripts, flows and procedures documented in the team repository and knowledge base so others can maintain them. Perform record/data audit functions to ensure compliance with policies and procedures. Maintain database(s) of logistics information, ensuring data quality and completeness. Shipment Visibility & Systems Support Support the implementation and ongoing management of logistics systems platforms to streamline transportation processes. Troubleshoot issues with data flow in TMS/SAP, WMS, YMS, Ortec, or other digital systems by identifying where the data failed, logging and prioritizing tickets by business impact, and escalating to IT, SAP consultants, the EDI team or external partners. Follow up on the corrective actions until closure, test fixes before they reach production, confirm with business users that the problem is resolved, and record root causes and fixes in the team knowledge base. Communicate with Shipment Visibility support teams and carrier GPS providers to guarantee successful onboarding and connection and implement solutions for shipment visibility and appointment scheduling issues with carriers. Data Analysis & Performance Collect, interpret, and analyze logistics data (product availability, transport and delivery reliability, sourcing and distribution) supporting the ~$1B logistics budget, and track product flow from origin to delivery via logistics systems. Track logistics KPIs and prepare performance reporting, including transit-time variance, shipment plan adherence, shipment visibility coverage, and cost per case, to support continuous process improvement and high-quality service. Cross-Functional Coordination & Training Work closely with IT and the business to deliver on CBI’s logistics systems journey Prepare and deliver training for internal and external users (such as plant and transportation teams, carriers and warehouses) of TMS, Shipment Visibility and Appointment Scheduling tools. This includes building training materials, step-by-step guides and quick reference documents, running hands-on sessions for new users, system changes or onboarding, and keeping attendance records. It also includes answering follow-up questions and gathering user feedback to update the materials and spot recurring issues.Communicate proactively with internal and external stakeholders to support issue resolution, status updates, and system adoption. Role-Specific Responsibilities: (≈20%) Document and analyze logistics processes and procedures (such as load planning, carrier tendering, appointment scheduling and freight settlement) using process maps and operational data (cost per case, on-time delivery, tender acceptance, detention hours) to find inefficiencies. Recommend improvements with their expected benefit and effort and, once approved, support their implementation through updated procedures, system configuration requests, user testing and training, to maximize delivery efficiency while minimizing costs. Monitor, log, and resolve operational incidents and exceptions (detentions, deviations, accidents, material damage, thefts, and production changes) by notifying plants, carriers and Security or Risk teams, and helping carry out other options such as reassigning loads, changing appointments or switching carriers to avoid disruptions to production schedules. Gather supporting documents for claims, check accessorial charges for rail car and truck shipments against contracts, dispute invalid charges and report recurring patterns by carrier, lane or facility. Participate in the planning, execution, and tracking of Logistics financial performance, and analyze the executability of the optimized network distribution design to provide operational insight. Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned, including but not limited to special projects and external partner presentations. Title: BANAMEX ANALISTA DE CARTERA DE CREDITO
Industries: Banking, Financial Services, and Investment Banking
Description: The Credit Portfolio Analyst II is an intermediate-level position responsible for conducting credit reviews, credit approval and monitoring the portfolio to identify credit migration in coordination with the Risk Management team. The overall objective of this role is to manage Citi's portfolio exposure to clients and counterparties globally. Job Responsibilities: Conduct risk assessments and client credit analyses with supervision. Review financial results and peer analyses to support the preparation of financial projections. Assist in the preparation of green-light and transaction approval memos. Support due diligence activities and the building of cash flow models and sensitivity analyses. Escalate credit concerns and updates to senior risk and business managers. Support the proposal of risk mitigation actions by staying informed of related developments in the portfolio and industry, and by understanding the credit process, policies, and Citi's risk appetite. Assist with portfolio review preparation and the conduct of stress tests. Build working relationships with various teams across the bank, including deal, coverage, and product teams. Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets. Support compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency. Provide input into the risk analysis of tools used to monitor Credit Risk Exposure Assist in the assessment of collateral risk and stress testing. Assist in the preparation of risk review materials for proactive risk management and to present to internal stakeholders. Assist in monitoring credit portfolio limits to ensure compliance with risk appetite limits. Leverages varied networks to recruit diverse talent; advocates for colleagues with diverse skillsets, styles, and experiences to gain career opportunities. Empathetically listens and understands others’ positions before acting on issues; works to amplify voices that are minimized in the workplace Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
